subject: Thank you for the quick delivery
body:
Dear team,

I just wanted to say thank you for getting last week's delivery to us a day early. We had an inspection on Thursday and having everything on the shelves made a real difference.

Your driver was also very patient with our lift, which is not the easiest.

Warm regards,
Begona Larrea
Residencia Los Robles

subject: Camino de Santiago news - autumn edition
body:
Dear friends and partners,

Welcome to the autumn edition of our residence newsletter.

This season we opened a new sensory garden, thanks to the work of our volunteers and the families of our residents. Our physiotherapy team has also started a morning walking group that now has more than twenty regular members.

In November we will hold an open day for neighbours and partner companies. Details will follow in our next issue.

Thank you for being part of our community.

Beatriz Fernandez
Residencia Camino de Santiago

You are receiving this newsletter because you work with our residence. Reply with UNSUBSCRIBE to stop receiving it.

subject: Many thanks to your customer service
body:
Hola,

A short note to thank Ana from your customer service team. She sorted out our account details over the phone in five minutes after we had been going round in circles for days.

Please pass on our thanks to her.

Best wishes,
Silvia Castro
Farmacia Lavapies

subject: Question about your nitrile gloves
body:
Good morning,

One of our nurses has developed a skin reaction and we are reviewing the gloves we use. Could you tell me whether your nitrile examination gloves are free of accelerators such as thiurams and carbamates?

If you have a technical data sheet or a declaration of conformity, I would be grateful if you could send it.

Kind regards,
Pablo Ortega
Centro de Salud Privado Chamberi

subject: Damaged boxes in yesterday's delivery
body:
Hello,

Yesterday's delivery arrived with two cartons crushed on one side and the contents partly wet. It looks like they were stored somewhere damp before reaching us.

I have taken photos and kept the cartons aside. Could you tell me how you want to handle this - should we wait for a collection, or will you issue a credit note?

This is the second time this year, so I would also appreciate it if you could check with the carrier.

Regards,
Unai Elorza
Farmacia Casco Viejo

subject: When will order PO-4471 arrive?
body:
Good afternoon,

We placed order PO-4471 last Tuesday and the tracking link still shows it as being prepared. Could you give me an estimated delivery date?

We have a clinic day on Monday, so it would help to know whether it will arrive before then.

Thank you,
Mikel Iriarte
Centro Medico Pamplona

subject: Do you stock latex-free tourniquets?
body:
Hello,

We are moving the whole clinic to latex-free materials. Before we change anything, I would like to know which of your products are certified latex-free, in particular tourniquets, plasters and bandages.

Is there a list on your website, or could you send one?

Many thanks,
Alberto Sanz
Clinica Medica Valladolid

subject: Monte Alto newsletter - October
body:
Hello everyone,

This is the October newsletter from Residencia Monte Alto.

- Our new activities room is open, with music therapy on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
- We welcomed three new nurses to the night team.
- The flu vaccination campaign for residents and staff starts next week.

We thank all our suppliers and partners for their support during the summer works.

Fernando Gil
Director, Residencia Monte Alto

subject: Delivery time for Barcelona
body:
Hi,

We are a new customer in Barcelona and I would like to understand your delivery times before we plan our stock. How many working days does a standard delivery to the Gracia area usually take, and is there a cut-off time for same-week delivery?

Thanks in advance,
Marta Puig
Clinica Podologica Gracia

subject: Ruzafa Dental - patient news and summer hours
body:
Dear colleagues and partners,

As every quarter, here is a short update from Clinica Dental Ruzafa.

We have finished renovating our two surgeries and we have a new hygienist on the team. From next month we will offer late appointments on Wednesdays.

We are also collecting used toothbrushes for a recycling project with a local school.

Best wishes from all the team,
Lucia Soler
Clinica Dental Ruzafa

subject: Is the delivery still on for Friday?
body:
Hello again,

The confirmation email for our last order said delivery on Friday, but we are closed in the afternoon because of a local holiday. Will the driver come in the morning, or should we ask for a different day?

Thank you,
Marta Puig

subject: Wrong size delivered again
body:
Good morning,

I am writing to complain about our last delivery. We received gloves in size L when we had asked for size M, and the staff only noticed after opening several boxes.

This has caused real problems on the night shift. I would like to know how this happened and how you will make sure it does not happen again. Please arrange a collection of the unopened boxes.

Regards,
Pilar Lacasa
Residencia Ribera del Ebro

subject: Thanks for the training session
body:
Hello,

On behalf of the nursing team, thank you for the session your product specialist gave us on wound dressings. Everyone found it very useful, and several staff members asked whether a follow-up session would be possible next year.

Kind regards,
Pilar Lacasa
Residencia Ribera del Ebro

subject: Invoice 2026-0815 - price difference
body:
Hello,

Our accounts team has spotted a difference on invoice 2026-0815. The unit price charged for the incontinence briefs is higher than the price in our annual agreement.

Could you check it and, if it is an error, send us a corrected invoice or a credit note for the difference? We will hold the payment of that invoice until we hear from you.

Thank you,
Encarna Sanchez
Residencia Las Acacias

subject: Casco Viejo pharmacy - news for our partners
body:
Kaixo!

Here is the latest news from Farmacia Casco Viejo.

We have extended our opening hours on Saturdays until 8 pm and we now offer free blood pressure checks every Monday morning. Our team also completed a course on dermocosmetics this summer.

Thank you to all the suppliers who helped us during the renovation of the shop front.

Unai Elorza
Farmacia Casco Viejo

To stop receiving these updates, just reply to this email.

subject: Invoice sent to the wrong address
body:
Hi,

We received your September invoice at our old address in Embajadores. Our billing address changed in June, and I thought this had been updated in your system.

Could you reissue the invoice with the correct address, Calle de Lavapies 22, and confirm that future invoices will go there?

Thanks,
Silvia Castro
Farmacia Lavapies

subject: Complaint about late deliveries
body:
Dear sirs,

Over the last month three of our deliveries have arrived between one and three days late, without any warning from your side. As a care home we cannot run short of basic supplies, and our staff had to borrow material from another residence.

I would like a call with your account manager this week to discuss what is going wrong.

Regards,
Vicente Marti
Residencia La Alameda

subject: Expired product received
body:
Hola,

In last Thursday's delivery we found two boxes of syringes with an expiry date of last month. We cannot sell or use them.

Please let me know how you want them returned and confirm that the value will be credited to our account. I would also ask you to review stock rotation at your warehouse.

Ximo Peris
Farmacia Benimaclet

subject: Indautxu Medical Centre - quarterly update
body:
Dear partners,

In this quarter's update from Centro Medico Indautxu:

Our new cardiology unit is fully running, with two specialists and extended hours. We have also moved our blood test room to the ground floor so that patients with reduced mobility can reach it more easily.

We would like to thank our suppliers for adapting their delivery windows during the move.

Best regards,
Iker Zubiri
Centro Medico Indautxu

subject: Great service this year
body:
Hi all,

Now that we have finished our first year working with you, I wanted to let you know how happy we are with the service. Deliveries have been on time and every question has been answered quickly.

We look forward to continuing next year.

Best,
Sara Lopez
Clinica de Fisioterapia Centro

subject: Question about compression stockings sizes
body:
Hello,

Some of our residents need compression stockings and our nurses are unsure about your sizing. Do you have a size chart that shows ankle and calf measurements for each size?

We would also like to know whether the class I stockings can be washed at 60 degrees.

Thank you,
Begona Larrea
Residencia Los Robles

subject: Thank you for the donation
body:
Dear team,

I am writing to thank you for the hygiene kits you donated for our residents' summer outing. The families were very touched, and we have shared a few photos on our noticeboard.

With gratitude,
Pilar Lacasa
Residencia Ribera del Ebro

subject: Farmacia Lakua - October newsletter
body:
Kaixo guztioi,

Our October newsletter is here.

This month we are running a free skin check campaign with a visiting dermatologist, and we have started home delivery for elderly customers in the Lakua neighbourhood.

We will be closed on 12 October for the bank holiday.

Thank you for your support,
Oier Bengoa
Farmacia Lakua

subject: Tracking number for our last order
body:
Egun on,

We received the confirmation for our last order, but there was no tracking number in the email. Could you send it to me so our reception staff can follow the delivery?

Mila esker,
Nerea Ochoa
Residencia San Prudencio

subject: Are your syringes compatible with our dental anaesthetic?
body:
Hello,

We use cartridge anaesthetic in the clinic and are looking at your luer lock syringes for irrigation. Can you confirm the material of the plunger and whether they are suitable for use with sodium hypochlorite?

Any technical documentation would be very welcome.

Regards,
Ruben Alvarez
Clinica Dental Gijon Centro

subject: Delivery to our new building
body:
Hello,

From 1 November we will receive goods at our new building on Paseo de Aiete 70 instead of the old address. Is there anything we need to do on our side so that pending and future deliveries go to the new address? Do you need a new delivery contact?

Thank you,
Xabier Lasa
Residencia Aiete

subject: Rude delivery driver
body:
Hello,

I am sorry to have to write this, but the driver who delivered to us on Monday was rude to our receptionist and left the boxes blocking the entrance for patients.

We have always had good service from you, so I am sure this is an exception, but I would like you to look into it.

Marta Puig
Clinica Podologica Gracia

subject: Blood pressure monitor validation
body:
Hi,

Before we replace the monitors in our consulting rooms, could you tell me whether your automatic upper arm monitor has been clinically validated, and to which protocol? We also need to know how often the manufacturer recommends recalibration.

Thanks,
Mikel Iriarte
Centro Medico Pamplona

subject: News from Clinica de Fisioterapia Centro
body:
Hello everyone,

Here is our seasonal newsletter.

We have launched a back-care programme for office workers and we now run pilates classes for patients after rehabilitation. Our team will present a poster on knee rehabilitation at the regional physiotherapy congress in December.

Thank you for reading, and see you soon,
Sara Lopez
Clinica de Fisioterapia Centro

subject: Thanks for solving the invoice issue
body:
Good morning,

Just a quick message to thank your accounts department for sorting out last month's invoice so quickly. Everything is now in order on our side.

All the best,
Mikel Iriarte
Centro Medico Pamplona

subject: Shelf life of your sterile gauze
body:
Bon dia,

We keep a small stock of sterile gauze for minor procedures, and our quality manager has asked me what shelf life your sterile gauze swabs have from the date of manufacture. Is it printed on each envelope or only on the outer box?

Gracies,
Jordi Ferrer
Centre Medic Eixample

subject: Duplicate invoice?
body:
Hello,

We seem to have received two invoices for the same delivery, numbers 2026-0902 and 2026-0907, with identical amounts and dates. Could you check whether one of them was issued by mistake and cancel it?

We do not want to pay twice.

Kind regards,
Irene Saenz
Clinica de Rehabilitacion Logrono

subject: Santander aesthetic clinic - autumn news
body:
Dear partners,

Welcome to our autumn newsletter.

We have added two treatment rooms and a new laser for skin rejuvenation. Our medical director will also give a free talk on sun damage at the city library on 20 November.

We appreciate your continued collaboration.

Paula Gutierrez
Centro de Estetica Medica Santander

subject: Partial delivery - rest of the order?
body:
Hi,

Yesterday we received part of our last order, and the delivery note says the remaining items are on back order. Do you know when they will be shipped? We just need a rough date to plan the next weeks.

Thanks,
Irene Saenz

subject: Poor quality masks
body:
Hola,

Several customers have returned surgical masks bought from us this month because the ear loops break as soon as they are put on. This has never happened with your products before.

Please can you check the batch and tell me what you will do about it? We have stopped selling them for now.

Ximo Peris
Farmacia Benimaclet

subject: Payment terms on recent invoices
body:
Good afternoon,

Our agreement says payment at 60 days, but your last two invoices show 30 days as the due date. Could you correct this in your system and confirm the due dates for those invoices?

Best regards,
Javier Moreno
Policlinica Malaga Este

subject: Thanks for the samples
body:
Hello,

Thank you for the dressing samples you sent last week. Our nurses have tried them and found them very comfortable for patients. We will be in touch if we decide to include them in our next purchases.

Best wishes,
Irene Saenz
Clinica de Rehabilitacion Logrono

subject: Copy of invoices for our auditor
body:
Dear team,

Our external auditor has asked for copies of all invoices from January to June. Would it be possible to send them as PDF files to this address?

Many thanks,
Begona Larrea
Residencia Los Robles

subject: Delivery on the island - extra charge?
body:
Bon dia,

We would like to know whether deliveries to Palma have a fixed delivery day each week, and whether there is any extra charge for the ferry. We are planning our purchases for the winter and need this information.

Moltes gracies,
Margalida Riera
Farmacia La Paz

subject: Missing items not refunded
body:
Buenas tardes,

Three weeks ago I reported that two items were missing from our delivery, and I was told a credit note would follow. We still have not received it, and nobody has answered my last two emails.

I would appreciate an answer this week.

Un saludo,
Manuel Romero
Centro Medico Triana

subject: Sunscreen for sensitive skin - which one?
body:
Hello,

Customers often ask us for a sunscreen suitable for very sensitive or atopic skin. Of the sunscreens in your catalogue, which ones are fragrance-free and dermatologically tested? Do you have any product leaflets we could display at the counter?

Thank you,
Alvaro Benitez
Farmacia del Puerto

subject: Bed protection - washable or disposable?
body:
Egun on,

We are comparing costs between disposable underpads and washable bed protectors. Do you have information on how absorbent your disposable underpads are, in ml, and whether they are suitable for use with pressure-relief mattresses?

Mila esker,
Nerea Ochoa
Residencia San Prudencio

subject: VAT rate on invoice 2026-0933
body:
Hello,

Invoice 2026-0933 applies the general VAT rate to the face masks, but our accountant believes they should carry the reduced rate. Could you check which rate is correct and, if needed, send a corrected invoice?

Kind regards,
Alvaro Benitez
Farmacia del Puerto

subject: Direct debit for invoices
body:
Arratsalde on,

We would like to pay your invoices by direct debit from next month instead of bank transfer. What do you need from us to set this up, and from which invoice would it apply?

Mila esker,
Josu Aguirre
Residencia Itsasbegi

subject: Centro Medico Pamplona - news for partners
body:
Dear partners,

Our autumn update from Centro Medico Pamplona:

- We have opened a travel medicine clinic with vaccination advice.
- Our new booking app is now live for patients.
- Car park works will finish at the end of the month; until then, please use the side entrance for deliveries.

Thank you for your patience and support.

Mikel Iriarte
Centro Medico Pamplona

subject: Can deliveries come before 9 am?
body:
Hola,

Our street becomes pedestrian-only from 9 am, and the last two drivers had trouble reaching the pharmacy. Would it be possible to schedule our deliveries before that time? If not, could the driver call us when nearby so we can meet them at the corner?

Gracias,
Rocio Dominguez
Farmacia Nervion

subject: Thank you for your flexibility
body:
Hi,

Thank you for changing our delivery slot at such short notice last week. It meant a lot to us during the flooding in the area.

Kind regards,
Rocio Dominguez
Farmacia Nervion

subject: Incorrect labelling on boxes
body:
Dear team,

The outer boxes in our last two deliveries had labels that did not match the contents, so our staff stored products in the wrong place. Luckily we noticed before anything was used.

This is a safety issue for us. Please check your labelling process and tell me what changes you will make.

Regards,
Vicente Marti
Residencia La Alameda

subject: Invoice not received for September
body:
Kaixo,

We have the delivery notes for September but have not received the invoice yet. Could you send it to us? Our accounts close on the 15th.

Eskerrik asko,
Ane Goikoetxea
Clinica Fisioterapia Deusto

subject: Request for an account statement
body:
Hello,

Could you send us a statement of our account showing all invoices and payments since July? Our figures and yours seem to differ by a small amount and we would like to reconcile them.

Salutacions,
Jordi Ferrer
Centre Medic Eixample

subject: Holiday closure and deliveries
body:
Hello,

Our clinic will be closed from 23 December to 2 January. If anything is already on its way to us in that period, could it be held at your warehouse until we reopen? Please let me know how you would like to handle it.

Thanks,
Laura Etxeberria
Clinica Dental Arenal

subject: Order confirmation never arrived
body:
Bon dia,

I am disappointed with how our last request was handled. We never received the confirmation email, nobody answered the phone, and in the end we found out from the driver what was coming.

Please make sure our contact details are correct and that someone gets back to us when we write.

Margalida Riera
Farmacia La Paz
